theorems.statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (lf rf : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D)))
      (@DefiKernel.Parallel.admit P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundaries left right)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    @DefiKernel.Parallel.Compatible P A D lf rf

theorems.name: DefiKernel.Parallel.admit_ok
theorems.statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (lf rf : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D)))
      (@DefiKernel.Parallel.admit P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundaries left right)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    And
      (@Eq.{1} Bool
        (@DefiKernel.Composition.validateCatalog P A D inst inst_1 inst_2
          (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.registry P A D cfg) (@DefiKernel.Composition.Config.catalog P A D cfg))
        true)
      (And
        (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
          (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg
            (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left) left)
          (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf))
        (And
          (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
            (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg
              (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right) right)
            (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) rf))
          (@DefiKernel.Parallel.Compatible P A D lf rf)))
theorems.source_statement:
theorem admit_ok (cfg : Config P A D) (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D)
    (left right : Branch P A D) (lf rf : Footprint P A D)
    (h : admit cfg boundaries left right = .ok (lf, rf)) :
    validateCatalog cfg.registry cfg.catalog = true ∧
    analyzeBranch cfg (boundaries .left) left = .ok lf ∧
    analyzeBranch cfg (boundaries .right) right = .ok rf ∧ Compatible lf rf

theorems.statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D) (boundary : Nat → DefiKernel.Composition.Boundary P A D) (index : Nat)
  (inv : DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) (tail : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D)
  (fp : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
      (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranchFrom P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundary index
        (@List.cons.{0} (DefiKernel.Composition.Invocation P A D) inv tail))
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) fp) →
    ∃ head rest,
      And
        (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Composition.Failure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
          (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeInvocation P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg (boundary index) inv)
          (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Composition.Failure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) head))
        (And
          (@Eq.{1} (Except.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
            (@DefiKernel.Parallel.analyzeBranchFrom P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundary
              (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) index
                (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
              tail)
            (@Except.ok.{0, 0} DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalFailure (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) rest))
          (@Eq.{1} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) fp (@DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.append P A D head rest)))
theorems.source_statement:
theorem analyzeBranchFrom_cons (cfg : Config P A D) (boundary : Nat → Boundary P A D)
    (index : Nat) (inv : Invocation P A D) (tail : Branch P A D) (fp : Footprint P A D)
    (h : analyzeBranchFrom cfg boundary index (inv :: tail) = .ok fp) :
    ∃ head rest, analyzeInvocation cfg (boundary index) inv = .ok head ∧
      analyzeBranchFrom cfg boundary (index + 1) tail = .ok rest ∧ fp = head.append rest

theorem analyzeBranchFrom_member (cfg : Config P A D) (boundary : Nat → Boundary P A D)
    (index : Nat) (branch : Branch P A D) (fp : Footprint P A D)

    ∃ part, analyzeInvocation cfg (boundary (index + n)) inv = .ok part ∧
      (∀ c ∈ part.reads, c ∈ fp.reads) ∧ (∀ c ∈ part.writes, c ∈ fp.writes)

theorems.source_statement:
theorem analyzeInvocation_coverage (cfg : Config P A D) (boundary : Boundary P A D)
    (inv : Invocation P A D) (fp : Footprint P A D)
    (h : analyzeInvocation cfg boundary inv = .ok fp) :
    ∃ component iface template,
      lookupOperation cfg.catalog inv.component inv.operation = some (component, iface) ∧
      cfg.registry inv.operation = some template ∧
      (∀ ref ∈ template.requiredStateReads ++ template.stateReads,
        ∃ c ∈ fp.reads, ref.2.resolve boundary.ctx.principal inv.parties = .ok c) ∧
      (∀ ref ∈ template.writes ++ template.deltas.map (fun d ↦ ⟨d.asset, d.target⟩),
        ∃ c ∈ fp.writes, ref.2.resolve boundary.ctx.principal inv.parties = .ok c) ∧
      (∀ output ∈ iface.outputs, output.cell ∈ fp.reads) ∧
      (∀ c ∈ fp.writes, c ∈ fp.reads)

theorem analyzeInvocation_ok (cfg : Config P A D) (boundary : Boundary P A D)
    (inv : Invocation P A D) (fp : Footprint P A D)
    (h : analyzeInvocation cfg boundary inv = .ok fp) :
    ∃ component iface template reads writes,
      lookupOperation cfg.catalog inv.component inv.operation = some (component, iface) ∧
      cfg.registry inv.operation = some template ∧
      resolveRefs boundary.ctx.principal inv.parties
        (template.requiredStateReads ++ template.stateReads) = .ok reads ∧
      resolveRefs boundary.ctx.principal inv.parties
        (template.writes ++ template.deltas.map (fun d ↦ ⟨d.asset, d.target⟩)) = .ok writes ∧
      checkAccess component template boundary.ctx inv.parties = .ok PUnit.unit ∧
      fp = ⟨reads ++ writes ++ iface.outputs.map OutputPort.cell, writes⟩

    (∀ c, c ∉ fp.writes → result.world.state.balance c = pre.state.balance c) ∧

theorem runParallel_accounting (cfg : Config P A D) (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D)
    (initial : World P A D) (left right : Branch P A D) (lf rf : Footprint P A D)
    (hadmit : admit cfg boundaries left right = .ok (lf, rf)) (d : D) (a : A) :
    total (mergeWorld lf rf initial
      (runBranch cfg (boundaries .left) initial left).world
      (runBranch cfg (boundaries .right) initial right).world).state d a =
      total initial.state d a +
        traceSupply (runBranch cfg (boundaries .left) initial left).events d a +
        traceSupply (runBranch cfg (boundaries .right) initial right).events d a

theorems.statement:
∀ {P A D : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} P] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{1} D]
  [inst_3 : Fintype.{0} P] [inst_4 : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_5 : Fintype.{0} D] (cfg : DefiKernel.Composition.Config P A D)
  (boundaries : DefiKernel.Parallel.ParallelBoundary P A D) (initial : DefiKernel.Composition.World P A D)
  (left right : DefiKernel.Parallel.Branch P A D) (lf rf : DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D),
  @Eq.{1}
      (Except.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D)))
      (@DefiKernel.Parallel.admit P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 cfg boundaries left right)
      (@Except.ok.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.AdmissionFailure P A D)
        (Prod.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D))
        (@Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) (DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint P A D) lf rf)) →
    ∀ (ls rs : Set.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D)) (lp rp : DefiKernel.Typed.State P A D → Prop),
      @DefiKernel.Composition.Supports P A D ls lp →
        @DefiKernel.Composition.Supports P A D rs rp →
          (∀ (c : DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D),
              @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (Set.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                  (@Set.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D)) ls c →
                c ∉ @DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D rf) →
            (∀ (c : DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D),
                @Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D) (Set.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D))
                    (@Set.instMembership.{0} (DefiKernel.Typed.Cell P A D)) rs c →
                  c ∉ @DefiKernel.Parallel.Footprint.writes P A D lf) →
              lp (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D initial) →
                rp (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D initial) →
                  @DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalPreservation P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                      (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left) lp →
                    @DefiKernel.Parallel.LocalPreservation P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                        (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right) rp →
                      And
                        (lp
                          (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D
                            (@DefiKernel.Parallel.mergeWorld P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 lf rf initial
                              (@DefiKernel.Composition.Cursor.world P A D
                                (@DefiKernel.Parallel.runBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                                  (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left) initial left))
                              (@DefiKernel.Composition.Cursor.world P A D
                                (@DefiKernel.Parallel.runBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                                  (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right) initial right)))))
                        (rp
                          (@DefiKernel.Typed.ExecutionResult.state P A D
                            (@DefiKernel.Parallel.mergeWorld P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 lf rf initial
                              (@DefiKernel.Composition.Cursor.world P A D
                                (@DefiKernel.Parallel.runBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                                  (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.left) initial left))
                              (@DefiKernel.Composition.Cursor.world P A D
                                (@DefiKernel.Parallel.runBranch P A D inst inst_1 inst_2 inst_3 inst_4 inst_5 cfg
                                  (boundaries DefiKernel.Parallel.BranchId.right) initial right)))))
theorems.source_statement:
theorem runParallel_two_invariants (cfg : Config P A D) (boundaries : ParallelBoundary P A D)
    (initial : World P A D) (left right : Branch P A D) (lf rf : Footprint P A D)
    (hadmit : admit cfg boundaries left right = .ok (lf, rf))
    (ls rs : Set (Cell P A D)) (lp rp : State P A D → Prop)
    (lSupport : Supports ls lp) (rSupport : Supports rs rp)
    (lpeer : ∀ c ∈ ls, c ∉ rf.writes) (rpeer : ∀ c ∈ rs, c ∉ lf.writes)
    (li : lp initial.state) (ri : rp initial.state)
    (lPreserves : LocalPreservation cfg (boundaries .left) lp)
    (rPreserves : LocalPreservation cfg (boundaries .right) rp) :
    lp (mergeWorld lf rf initial (runBranch cfg (boundaries .left) initial left).world
      (runBranch cfg (boundaries .right) initial right).world).state ∧
    rp (mergeWorld lf rf initial (runBranch cfg (boundaries .left) initial left).world
      (runBranch cfg (boundaries .right) initial right).world).state

premises_and_limits: Generic identity types P/A/D are Type; decidable equality and finite enumerations are retained where required. Exact elaborated quantifiers and premises appear in statement.

Correspondence covers binary finite invocation-only branches; admission may refuse; no invocation-success premise. Boundaries and registry/catalog/environment are trusted and fixed per branch/local index.
Expression/executor dependency fixes request, non-state inputs and store; resolved reads and effect targets are established from checked admission at the composition layer.
Initialized invariant composition requires initial predicates, explicit local one-step preservation, support and peer-disjointness. Environment assumptions and deployed fidelity are not discharged.
Imported generated theorem counts are not counts of independent mathematical results. Runtime comparisons, mutation executions and infrastructure controls are separate evidence inventories.
